name: Simple Exports
description: One click: front.png, back.png and schematic.png in the project's img folder
description_full:
Adds a toolbar button to the PCB editor that writes three images into an img folder next to the board:

- front.png and back.png: orthographic 3D renders in the board's stackup colours, trimmed to the board on a transparent background
- schematic.png: the root schematic sheet, 2400 px wide

No per-board setup: parts come from their 3D models and rendering uses the running KiCad's kicad-cli. The schematic is rasterised with Inkscape when it is installed, otherwise with wxWidgets (which leaves out embedded bitmaps such as title-block logos). Progress and the result appear in one small window, and the export can be cancelled.
